reading.body:
UPS battery health and generator runtime track battery state of health and remaining runtime under current load, alongside on-site fuel measured in hours of generator operation at load.

The ride-through chain, the sequence of backup systems that keep a facility powered during a grid failure, is described as only as real as its weakest measurement, batteries age silently without an obvious external sign, and fuel contracts measured in days assume deliveries that a regional emergency can interrupt. That framing treats backup power less as a fixed asset and more as a continuously decaying one that requires active monitoring to trust.

It sits with network latency, packet loss, and bandwidth, and SLA uptime compliance under Uptime and redundancy, together covering the different components, power backup, network reliability, and contractual compliance, that determine whether a facility's promised availability holds up in practice.
